summary: Layout check only: in Evaluación Oftalmológica > Examen Oftalmológico > Agudeza Visual, 'AV Binocular' and 'AV Cerca' now sit on the same row, side by side, below 'Con Corrección'. Both inputs are narrower than before and can still be edited. Logged in as superadmin/nova2024, patient 4ceb89de-628f-4aa9-a545-fe6c4f4affc5.

issues: At 1366px the AV Binocular input is only ~70px wide (AV Cerca ~90px). '20/25' still fits, but longer values like '20/200 PH' would get cut off. Minor; optional fix: give the inputs a min-width or let the 2-column grid stack into one column on narrow cards.

The whole page appears wider than the viewport at tablet width: the right edge of the content is cut off. This looks like it existed before this change and is not caused by the AV row. No overflow inside the AV grid itself.

action_items: Optional: add a min-width to the AV Binocular and AV Cerca inputs for 1366px screens
critical_code_review_comments: The grid-cols-2 block with flex Label+Input is clean and keeps the data-testids. Both Labels use whitespace-nowrap, so on narrow cards the Inputs end up with whatever width is left over.
